scheme_name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
other_conditions: Must be a member of a rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled work.
Must be an adult (18 years or older) member of the household.
Must be a resident of the local Gram Panchayat area.
benefits_summary: Provides up to 100 days of guaranteed wage employment per year to rural households, with wages paid directly to bank or post office accounts.
